verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no first-party (GitHub) documentation of an official Solid Router or its integration; the only routing-related mention is a community complaint that 'SolidStart routing... can be very slow with no workaround' (solid-comm-15), which is negative and unsupported by any vendor-tier claim to create a genuine two-tier dispute. Missing for 10: first-party docs/README mention of an official router package, feature list of router APIs, and any independent corroboration of smooth integration.
